items.headline: Anthropic backers target a ~$2 trillion IPO in October (largest ever, would eclipse SpaceX's $1.77T June debut); MS/GS/JPM leading; ~$47B ARR by May, $100-120B projected by Dec; figure is investor speculation, not company-confirmed

Markets (wk of Aug 10-14): July CPI +0.1% (3.4% annual), core 2.5%, PPI flat -> September Fed hike odds fell to ~32%, funds rate held 3.50-3.75%; S&P 500 hit record Thu then slipped ~0.2% Fri for a 3rd straight weekly gain; QQQ ~$731; retail sales soft, Michigan sentiment dour
AI coding-tools funding wave: Lovable raises $400M Series C (Menlo, EQT, CapitalG; ~$500M run-rate); CodeRabbit raises $143M Series C (Atomico, Smash Capital, GV, BMW i Ventures, YC)
Form Energy raises $750M Series G (T. Rowe Price lead; Sequoia, Coatue, Janus Henderson, Franklin Templeton) to scale iron-air multi-day grid storage
Skan AI raises $63M (Cathay Innovation, Dell Technologies Capital) for an enterprise 'context graph' that maps org workflows for AI agents
Mindgard raises $30M for cybersecurity purpose-built for AI systems and autonomous agents
Yulu raises $93M Series C (GEF Capital lead; Bajaj Auto, Magna International) for India EV micro-mobility, scaling toward 200,000 electric two-wheelers
Vuelta a España 2026 starts Aug 22 with a foreign grand départ in Monaco (9km ITT); Pogačar overwhelming favorite chasing his first Vuelta (career Grand Slam) after a record-equaling 5th Tour
Humanoid deployment counts rise: Figure's third-gen robot passes 1,000 units, AgiBot ~15,000 cumulative, Boston Dynamics electric Atlas deployments underway in Hyundai plants
HappyRobot raises $150M Series C (a16z, Base10, YC) for autonomous AI voice/email agents handling logistics workflows
